title: Subnautica Internal Modules
body:
This mod adds not only internal modules, but also a lot more! I made this mod in McReator, solo, and I will ALWAYS, ALWAYS post mods for version 1.21.1 of Neoforge, as that's the version I built with a friend! So, this mod adds a Fabricator, a First Aid Kit Fabricator, a Radio, and a Wall Cabinet. Everything except the Wall Cabinet is decorative! LOL. The mod is still in beta and is only available in English (forgive me, a sinner 😅). You can mine titanium from limestone outcrops, along with copper. It can be mined with a stone pickaxe. That's all I'll say about the mod, have a nice game! WARNING! their models have reversed, so place it backwards. 
Google Translate is used. Thank you.
